info.name: Restoring the Memory of the Ancient Bow

descriptions.notStarted: #b#@9201122:##k in #b#m101010102##k says he'd like to restore his lost memory.
descriptions.inProgress: He said his memory has been sealed, and has asked you to hunt the #rGreen Mushrooms#k nearby and bring back 20 #rMemory Fragments#k.\n\nReport back to #b#@9201122:##k in #b#m101010102##k upon completion.
descriptions.completed: The legend of the bow was about #rSolomon's Bow#k. But something seems incomplete.
